content.text: Beliefs are **inconsistent** when they cannot all be true together. If yours are, at least one is false, so something has to change.

content.definition: A statement that would be false if it were true, because it applies to itself.

examples.title: An inconsistent set
examples.note: If the first two are true, the third is false. They cannot all be true.

examples.title: Self-refuting
lines: I know that no one can know anything.
examples.note: Each one, if true, would make itself false.

question.prompt: What is wrong with 'All generalizations are false'?
options: It is a generalization, so it refutes itself
question.explanation: The statement is a generalization. If it were true, it would be false, so it refutes itself.
